verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a crypto payments platform could plausibly offer API wallet provisioning, but the evidence shows no API endpoint for creating per-customer or per-purpose wallets or deposit addresses, and no documented key custody semantics. The only wallet mention is end-user wallet creation by email inside the widget purchase flow. That is an adjacent, user-driven feature, not programmatic provisioning, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create wallets programmatically — per-customer or per-purpose wallets and deposit addresses provisioned through the API with documented key custody semantics
